# MySpaFilter

> Independent hot tub / spa filter cross-reference. Look up a cartridge by OEM, Unicel, Pleatco or Filbur part number and get equivalents, dimensions, fittings and the catalog page each match comes from (Unicel 2026 Replacement Guide, Pleatco 2023 catalog, Filbur catalog; model-year fitment from cited dealer listings). Unconfirmed rows are flagged as unverified. Affiliate retailer links are disclosed.

## Key pages
- [Home / search by part number, size (inches or mm) or spa brand](https://myspafilter.com/)
- [Filter cross-reference lookup](https://myspafilter.com/tools/cross-reference/): type an OEM, Unicel, Pleatco, or Filbur number already in the dataset and see the equivalent numbers, dimensions, and filter pages. It does not invent a match.
- [When to replace or clean](https://myspafilter.com/tools/filter-schedule/): dates from the intervals Hot Spring, Jacuzzi, Sundance, Unicel, and Pleatco publish. Where those pages disagree, the page shows the range. The reminder form only stores a request. It does not send email and it is not a newsletter.
- [Filter replacement schedule and reorder](https://myspafilter.com/tools/filter-reorder/): pick a brand, model, or part number already in the dataset. The page counts only the manufacturer interval that applies to that cartridge, lists the OEM, Unicel, Pleatco and Filbur numbers, and gives a buy link. It does not print a price. A gift note for a spare filter set and cleaning tools runs through December 24, 2026, with USPS and UPS send-by dates.
- [Find a filter by size](https://myspafilter.com/size/)
- [Measuring guide](https://myspafilter.com/guide/)
- [Guides index](https://myspafilter.com/guides/)
- [Dataset: all cartridges as an HTML table, with CSV and JSON downloads and a citation snippet](https://myspafilter.com/data/) ([CSV](https://myspafilter.com/data/spa-filters.csv), [JSON](https://myspafilter.com/data/spa-filters.json))
- Model-year lookups: [Hot Spring filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/hot-spring-filter-by-model-year/) (also covers Hot Spot and Solana models), [Caldera filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/caldera-filter-by-model-year/), [Jacuzzi filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/jacuzzi-filter-by-model-year/), [Sundance filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/sundance-filter-by-model-year/), [Bullfrog filter by series and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/bullfrog-filter-by-model-year/), [Master Spas filter by series and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/master-spas-filter-by-model-year/), [Marquis filter by series and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/marquis-filter-by-model-year/), [Dimension One filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/dimension-one-filter-by-model-year/), [Nordic Hot Tubs filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/nordic-hot-tubs-filter-by-model-year/), [Arctic Spas filter by year and series](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/arctic-spas-filter-by-model-year/), [Softub filter by year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/softub-filter-by-model-year/), [Intex PureSpa filter by set number and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/intex-filter-by-model-year/), [Bestway Lay-Z-Spa and SaluSpa filter by model and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/bestway-filter-by-model-year/), [Beachcomber filter by year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/beachcomber-filter-by-model-year/) (25 and 50 sq ft share one body from 1995; pre-1995 is a shorter two-piece set), [Strong Spas filter by series and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/strong-spas-filter-by-model-year/) (Strong’s FAQ gives 50 or 75 sq ft and no part number; the catalogs’ 20 sq ft Antigua cartridge disagrees on length), [Freeflow filter by model](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/freeflow-filter-by-model-year/) (TLX/RLX vs CLX: Unicel and Filbur/Pleatco swap which model is the open top; Legend is 45 or 50 sq ft), [Freedom Spas filter by model](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/freedom-spas-filter-by-model-year/) (Franklin and Statesman are named on both 4CH-30 and 6CH-45; a 1993 note sits on two rows with no model name), [PDC Spas filter by series and year](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/pdc-spas-filter-by-model-year/) (PDC’s 2025 guide: Luxury/Premium/SE/LX = FLT-201TL; River and the XD2 spa side = FLT-171-CART at 25 sq ft, which the catalogs rate at 50 for the set; the XD2 cold side from 2024 is the threaded FLT-1000-CART), [Waterway filter by housing](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/waterway-filter-by-model-year/) (817-0050 is one front-access cartridge or two side by side; 817-0011 stacks on 817-0012; the 6" body is 50, 45, or 40 sq ft depending on the list), [Saratoga filter by part number](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/saratoga-spas-filter-by-model-year/) (20241-238 is 20 sq ft in Unicel and 25 in Pleatco; the same 6-3/4" body with a 1-1/4" SAE thread is 4CH-920 and has no OEM number), [Coleman Spas filter by part number](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/coleman-spas-filter-by-model-year/) (3301-xxxx through 2001, 100xxx since 2002; three lengths each in 1-1/2" MPT and 2" MPT; OEM 100520 is 32 sq ft in Unicel and Filbur and 35 sq ft in Pleatco), [Maax Spas filter by model](https://myspafilter.com/fitment/maax-spas-filter-by-model-year/) (Elegant, Intrigue and Joli = OEM 108868; Elite = OEM 104309, printed at 35 sq ft and at 50 sq ft)
- Brands: [Beachcomber](https://myspafilter.com/beachcomber/), [Bullfrog](https://myspafilter.com/bullfrog/), [Cal Spas](https://myspafilter.com/cal-spas/), [Caldera](https://myspafilter.com/caldera/), [Coleman Spas](https://myspafilter.com/coleman-spas/), [Dimension One Spas](https://myspafilter.com/dimension-one-spas/), [Freedom Spas](https://myspafilter.com/freedom-spas/), [Freeflow Spas](https://myspafilter.com/freeflow-spas/), [Hot Spot](https://myspafilter.com/hot-spot/), [Hot Spring](https://myspafilter.com/hot-spring/), [Intex](https://myspafilter.com/intex/), [Jacuzzi](https://myspafilter.com/jacuzzi/), [Maax Spas](https://myspafilter.com/maax-spas/), [Marquis Spas](https://myspafilter.com/marquis-spas/), [Master Spas](https://myspafilter.com/master-spas/), [PDC Spas](https://myspafilter.com/pdc-spas/), [Saratoga Spas](https://myspafilter.com/saratoga-spas/), [Softub](https://myspafilter.com/softub/), [Solana](https://myspafilter.com/solana/), [Strong Spas](https://myspafilter.com/strong-spas/), [Sundance](https://myspafilter.com/sundance/), [Waterway](https://myspafilter.com/waterway-plastics/)

- [Discontinued spa filter numbers and their replacements](https://myspafilter.com/guides/discontinued-spa-filter-part-numbers/): the replacement Unicel and Pleatco name for retired hot tub filter cartridges, what changes in size, area or thread, and where the lists disagree
- [Hot tub filter after a flood, hurricane, or power outage](https://myspafilter.com/guides/hot-tub-filter-after-flood-or-power-outage/): Master Spas says clean the filters after a hurricane; North Carolina’s October 2024 Helene sheet says replace and clean as needed if the tub was flooded or not maintained, and not to refill under a boil-water notice; CDC’s toolkit says clean and service filters when nobody is ill, and replace them when an outbreak is suspected

## Holiday 2026
Dates below are the published calendar and carrier dates. The pages do not list a price, a percent off, or a countdown.
- [Black Friday hot tub filters and spa care](https://myspafilter.com/guides/black-friday-hot-tub-filter-and-spa-care/): spare cartridges, chemicals and covers; Black Friday is Friday, November 27, 2026, and Cyber Monday is Monday, November 30, 2026; USPS and UPS send-by dates for Christmas delivery.
- [Gifts for hot tub owners 2026](https://myspafilter.com/guides/gifts-for-hot-tub-owners-2026/)
- [Winter spa care](https://myspafilter.com/guides/winter-spa-care/): cover, filter and water, from Hot Spring, CDC and CPSC. No universal winterizing recipe.
